# Heat stress covered 84.4% of global reef area during the fourth bleaching event

The fourth global coral bleaching event was confirmed on April 15, 2024. Separately, satellite data show bleaching-level heat stress across roughly 84.4% of global reef area from January 2023 through September 2025.

That measured footprint exceeds the 68.2% recorded during the 2014–2017 event. Mass bleaching was documented in at least 83 countries and territories.

The record is based on reef area exposed to bleaching-level heat stress. It does not mean that every exposed reef bleached or died.
